notes_for_editor: Only three pages.The 1926 item is a newspaper report reprinted on a local history site; the 1952 map is a Pastmaps reprint whose prose is a site blurb (the BM 48 label is from its feature list); the OSM point is a map entry, not proof a structure stands. The OSM node is matched to the map tower by name only (no coordinates for the site were compared), so the story no longer says the point sits on the same spot.No build date, builder, staffing, fires or fate found. A Taylor County & Perry history Facebook post and photo (a 1947 forestry field day at the Florida Forest Service's Secotan Fire Tower and radio station beside Hwy. 19 North) surfaced only in search snippets; both Facebook pages refused to open, so nothing from them is cited. Worth a human check: it would date use and name the agency. The brief's elevation (14 m) comes from the OSM node. Not on the NHLR Florida list (31) or the FFLOS Florida list (6) in the cache. Record county is null but sources place it in Taylor County; no correction proposed. Status unknown.
